description: CS with overlap capacitances only (CGSO, CGDO: constant, so linear in .disto too). HD2 and HD3 vs frequency through the Miller pole and the C_gd feedthrough. Junction (CJ, CJE, CJC, CJO) and Meyer capacitances are bias-dependent, nonlinear charges in ngspice's .disto, which the solver's linear-capacitance Volterra does not model, so they are not in the distortion corpus.
